description_en: Invoke the GetRecordUrl API to obtain the incoming and outgoing calls recording link
description_zh: 调用GetRecordUrl接口获取语音双呼录音链接
kebab_example: aliyun aiccs get-record-url --instance-id ccc_xp_pre-cn-0000 --acid 10010670000 --record-type DUP_CALL --api-version 2019-10-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetRecordUrl

parameters.help_en: The Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service (AICCS) instance ID. You can obtain it in the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview) > Instance Management
parameters.help_zh: AICCS实例ID。可在智能联络中心控制台 (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)>实例管理中获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The call type. Valid values:

DUP_CALL: Incoming and outgoing calls.
IVR_CALL: IVR outbound call.
SMART_CALL: Intelligent outbound call
parameters.help_zh:
呼叫类型。取值：

DUP_CALL：双呼。
IVR_CALL：IVR外呼。
SMART_CALL：智能外呼
parameters.name: record_type
